notes.title: 09/Oct/2021
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented some Midi files from being loaded.
When playing sounds from other channels as background music, the volume of the Midi file is now referenced.
When auto-playing, the currently playing channel will now also play sound.
There are still some Midi files that cannot be loaded, but we are planning to fix them.

notes.title: 02/Oct/2021
notes.notes: I had also uploaded unnecessary files, so I deleted them.

notes.title: 02/Oct/2021
notes.notes:
Changed the UI.
If the Midi file is SMF compatible, the sound corresponding to the instrument will now be played.
Added auto play mode to preview the song.
Added the ability to select your own instrument to play.
Fixed some bugs.
The number of history folders is now limited to 100, and the oldest ones will be deleted when the number exceeds 100.
Added the ability to scroll through songs.
Added the ability to select a channel to play on.
